criteria.demonstration: The bounded byte adapter rejects out-of-view indices in every mode, admits NULL only for an empty span, preserves bytes on refusal and preflights report exhaustion. Valid writes remain possible at reportMAX. Shared counter and byte paths use one actual mutex and the same report owner; snapshot stages under lock. Lock admission failure has no effect, unexpected unlock failure is explicitly fatal because state may have committed, and initialization/destruction require fresh or joined quiescent ownership.
